item.title: 🔴 New GigaWiper Windows Backdoor Bundles Disk Wiping, Fake Ransomware, and Spyware
item.description:
Why this matters: Elevated ransomware risk — validate backups and endpoint defenses.
Microsoft has taken apart a destructive Windows backdoor it calls GigaWiper. What stands out is how it is built: not one tool but three older destructive programs bolted into one, offered as commands the operator can choose from. Each is a different way to break a machine: wipe the whole disk, overwrite the Windows drive, or run fake "ransomware" that scrambles files with a key it never saves

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 3h ago

item.title: 🔵 npm 12 Disables Install Scripts by Default to Reduce Supply Chain Risk
item.description:
Why this matters: Supply chain risk — audit third-party dependencies and vendor access.

item.title: 🔴 GodDamn Ransomware Uses PoisonX Driver to Disable Endpoint Defenses
item.description:
Why this matters: Elevated ransomware risk — validate backups and endpoint defenses.
